+_CLIXML_HEADER = re.compile(rb"(?:#<|<#) CLIXML\r\n|\r\nCLIXML\r\n")
+_CLIXML_LINE_HEADER = re.compile(rb"(?:#<|<#) CLIXML\r\n")

+
+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML blocks in Windows stderr, preserving other bytes."""
+    if b"CLIXML\r\n" not in stderr:
+        return stderr
+
+    output = bytearray()
+    cursor = 0
+
+    headers: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
+    offset = 0
+    for line in stderr.splitlines(keepends=True):
+        headers.extend((offset + match.start(), offset + match.end()) for match in _CLIXML_LINE_HEADER.finditer(line))
+        if line.startswith(b"CLIXML\r\n") and stderr[max(0, offset - 2):offset] == b"\r\n":
+            headers.append((offset - 2, offset + len(b"CLIXML\r\n")))
+        offset += len(line)
+
+    for header_start, header_end in headers:
+        if header_start < cursor:
+            continue
+
+        xml_start = header_end
+        # PowerShell can emit another header before the first XML element.
+        while nested_header := _CLIXML_HEADER.match(stderr, xml_start):
+            xml_start = nested_header.end()
+
+        if not stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", xml_start):
+            continue
+
+        end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", xml_start)
+        if end == -1:
+            continue
+        end += len(b"</Objs>")
+
+        # A single CLIXML sequence can contain several adjacent Objs elements.
+        while True:
+            next_start = end
+            while stderr[next_start:next_start + 2] == b"\r\n":
+                next_start += 2
+            while next_header := _CLIXML_HEADER.match(stderr, next_start):
+                next_start = next_header.end()
+            if not stderr.startswith(b"<Objs ", next_start):
+                break
+            next_end = stderr.find(b"</Objs>", next_start)
+            if next_end == -1:
+                break
+            end = next_end + len(b"</Objs>")
+
+        block = stderr[header_start:end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                decoded = block.decode("utf-8")
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                decoded = block.decode("cp437")
+            replacement = _parse_clixml(decoded.encode("utf-8"))
+        except (ET.ParseError, UnicodeError, ValueError):
+            continue
+
+        output.extend(stderr[cursor:header_start])
+        output.extend(replacement)
+        cursor = end
+
+    if cursor == 0:
+        return stderr
+    output.extend(stderr[cursor:])
+    return bytes(output)

+_ERROR_XML = b'<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">error</S></Objs>'
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('stderr, expected', [
+    (b'plain stderr\r\n', b'plain stderr\r\n'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML, b'error'),
+    (b'before\r\n#< CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML + b'after\r\n', b'before\r\nerrorafter\r\n'),
+    (b'prefix #< CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML + b' trailing', b'prefix error trailing'),
+    (b'before\r\nCLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML + b'after', b'beforeerrorafter'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1">\r\n<S S="Error">error</S>\r\n</Objs>tail', b'errortail'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML + b'\r\n#< CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML, b'error\r\nerror'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML + _ERROR_XML, b'error\r\nerror'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<# CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML, b'error'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">caf\x82</S></Objs>', 'caf\u00e9'.encode()),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">broken</Objs>',
+     b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">broken</Objs>'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">incomplete</S>',
+     b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">incomplete</S>'),
+    (b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1">\r\n<S S="Error">incomplete</S>\r\n',
+     b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1">\r\n<S S="Error">incomplete</S>\r\n'),
+])
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml(stderr, expected):
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(stderr) == expected

+
+def test_replace_stderr_clixml_after_invalid_block():
+    invalid = b'#< CLIXML\r\n<Objs Version="1.1.0.1"><S S="Error">broken</Objs>\r\n'
+    assert ssh._replace_stderr_clixml(invalid + b'#< CLIXML\r\n' + _ERROR_XML) == invalid + b'error'
